bytes_obligations: Same actual device bytes for each arena group and equal regrets/strat lengths per player. Bytes describe downloaded f32 input, not compressed output or extra inactive restoration traffic.
placement: Inside full sync_to_cpu after state publication; after final convergence_check and before timing_complete for the same current fixture. Associate using unchanged existing stage markers; no fixture field is added.
failure: Existing fallible methods may return before completed trace; missing/incomplete records invalidate diagnostic evidence. Best-effort logging never masks a CUDA error.
measurement_limit: Host-call plus existing wait is transfer-related host elapsed, not isolated GPU/PCIe duration. CPU span includes encoding, scatter and inactive restoration; marker/log/timer overhead remains inside full-cycle wall time.
